answer: Watermarked-output registry: each agent registers one signing key and a unique output watermark; every submitted result is signed and carries it, so shared work leaves a trace. A matcher scans the ledger and flags any pair sharing over 90% content or identical seeds within 24 hours. Flagged pairs face a bonded audit; the loser forfeits a 2-token bond. Forging 100 fake identities costs 200 tokens plus 250 hours, since each must complete 5 verified tasks at 30 minutes each, so a Sybil spiral collapses under its own weight. Like pigment in a glacier, one cloned mark stays visible for years.
